name: Hunker Down
description:
Trigger: Your turn starts and you have spent no actions, reactions or movement yet.

Skip your turn. At the start of your next turn, if you are not Helpless, you regain Endurance equal to twice your body score.

Describe how you catch your breath.

improvements.name: Brace Yourself
improvements.description: You also gain +2 temporary Defense for 1 round.
